exposure: overnight intracervical laminaria placement followed by misoprostol
outcome: time from misoprostol administration to delivery
cohort: 126 women undergoing 2nd trimester induction of labor (IOL) with misoprostol between 1/2000 and 12/2010, excluding those with preterm labor, preterm premature rupture of membranes, or if misoprostol was not the primary induction agent.
finding: The use of laminaria tents for overnight cervical preparation does not expedite delivery times in patients undergoing 2nd trimester IOL with misoprostol; the laminaria group had a longer mean time to delivery (19 h vs 13 h, p = .007) and fewer women completed abortion at 24 hrs (61% vs 90%, p <=.001).
